evals.name: greenfield-no-claude-md
evals.prompt: Apply baseline coding rules to this project. There is no CLAUDE.md yet — create one with the standard baseline ruleset.
evals.expected_output: A new CLAUDE.md is created at the project root containing all 6 baseline rules using the canonical wording verbatim, wrapped in the standard insertion frame (intro line + tradeoff caveat + rules + closing success line).
expectations: A file named CLAUDE.md exists at the fixture root after execution.
CLAUDE.md contains a section titled '## Baseline Coding Discipline'.
CLAUDE.md contains the heading '### 1. Think Before Coding'.
CLAUDE.md contains the heading '### 2. Simplicity First'.
CLAUDE.md contains the heading '### 3. Surgical Changes'.
CLAUDE.md contains the heading '### 4. Goal-Driven Execution'.
CLAUDE.md contains the heading '### 5. Fail Fast vs Graceful Handling'.
CLAUDE.md contains the heading '### 6. Documentation Priority'.
CLAUDE.md contains the canonical phrase 'Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.' verbatim.
CLAUDE.md contains the closing success line starting with 'These guidelines are working if:'.
All baseline rule content is in English (no Korean/translated text inside the rule bodies).
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the canonical Rule 2 verbatim phrase 'Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the canonical Rule 3 verbatim phrase 'Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the canonical Rule 4 verbatim phrase 'Define success criteria. Loop until verified.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the canonical Rule 5 verbatim phrase 'Match error handling to the failure source.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the canonical Rule 6 verbatim phrase 'Documentation is an attention budget, not a knowledge dump.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the standard insertion-frame intro line 'Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the standard tradeoff caveat starting with 'Tradeoff: These guidelines bias toward caution over speed.'

evals.name: normalize-paraphrased-rules
evals.prompt: This project's CLAUDE.md already has some ad-hoc rules that overlap with the baseline coding discipline set. Normalize the file: replace paraphrased rules with canonical wording and add any missing rules so the full baseline set is present exactly once.
evals.expected_output: CLAUDE.md is modified so that ad-hoc paraphrases (e.g., 'Avoid over-engineering', 'Stay focused on the task') are replaced with the canonical Rule 2 (Simplicity First) and Rule 3 (Surgical Changes) wording. Missing baseline rules are inserted. After execution, all 6 canonical rule headings appear, each exactly once, and the original ad-hoc headings are removed.
expectations: CLAUDE.md contains '### 2. Simplicity First' exactly once.
CLAUDE.md contains '### 3. Surgical Changes' exactly once.
CLAUDE.md no longer contains the original ad-hoc heading '## Avoid Over-Engineering'.
CLAUDE.md no longer contains the original ad-hoc heading '## Stay Focused'.
CLAUDE.md contains all 6 canonical rule headings ('### 1. Think Before Coding' through '### 6. Documentation Priority').
Each of the 6 canonical rule headings appears exactly once (no duplicates).
The canonical phrase 'Minimum code that solves the problem.' appears verbatim in CLAUDE.md.
The canonical phrase 'Touch only what you must.' appears verbatim in CLAUDE.md.
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the canonical Rule 1 verbatim phrase 'Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the canonical Rule 4 verbatim phrase 'Define success criteria. Loop until verified.'
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md preserves project-specific sections '## Project Layout' and '## Build Commands' from the input.
DISCRIMINATING: CLAUDE.md contains the standard insertion-frame intro line 'Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes.'
